baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sole rooted focus word is samiduna (س م د), word 2, predicated of the addressed plural in wa-antum samidun.
baseline_models.mechanism: The heedless-diversion branch makes the state active rather than empty: song, entertainment, or self-distraction occupies the channel that could receive the address.

activation_trace.role: Heedless diversion and song supply an attention-filling practice, functioning as the clause's active screen.

changed_reading.before: The clause merely labels an undifferentiated inattentive state.
changed_reading.after: You are actively keeping yourselves occupied, even sonically entertained, so attention cannot settle on the address.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Samiduna at focus word 2 can encode a bodily stance as well as a mental condition.
baseline_models.mechanism: Raising the head and standing upright externalize pride or bewilderment; the group's interpretation is carried by posture, not only by cognition.

activation_trace.role: Raised head, upright standing, pride, and bewilderment supply the visible posture and its two live motives.

changed_reading.before: The audience is mentally heedless with no specified bodily expression.
changed_reading.after: The audience stands head-up, either self-elevating or transfixed in bewilderment; both motives remain live.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus participle samiduna, word 2, can draw simultaneously on the travel and duration branches of س م د.
baseline_models.mechanism: Straight-ahead travel without fatigue combines with continuity to produce sustained momentum: this is persistence in a course, not static loitering.

activation_trace.role: Pressing straight ahead without fatigue or turning supplies the group's directional persistence.
Ongoing permanence extends that motion into a durative state that resists interruption.

changed_reading.before: Samud is a stationary lapse of attention.
changed_reading.after: You keep driving along the same course without turning aside, and you prolong that course as though it could continue indefinitely.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same focus word samiduna, word 2, has a branch of silence, stillness, sorrow, humility, and composure.
baseline_models.mechanism: The outwardly quiet state can hold sorrow or stunned composure rather than carefree amusement, preserving an affectively opposite baseline.

activation_trace.role: Stillness and sorrowful or humble composure supply a quiet, arrested affect that coexists with the diversion reading.

changed_reading.after: You may instead be silent and affectively arrested, carrying sorrow, humility, or stunned composure without yet responding.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's straight-ahead travel is placed inside a repeated descent field: a fall opens the surah and rapid projection accompanies the late casting-down. Forward persistence can therefore be a trajectory into collapse rather than escape from it.

activation_trace.role: Unturning forward travel supplies the focus group's sustained trajectory.
Falling into a depth supplies the opening downward vector that reorients the focus's forward motion.
Rapid projection through travel supplies a late kinetic bridge between pressing onward and being cast down.

structural_cues: The surah opens with descent, returns to casting down at 53:53, and then predicates a continuing plural state at 53:61.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies falling, rapid projection, and the focus's straight-ahead travel; I infer that sustained forwardness carries the group into descent rather than away from it; alternatively B001 may mark persistence without any spatial consequence.

changed_reading.before: The audience is stationary and inattentive.
changed_reading.after: You are still charging onward, but the context bends that onwardness into a self-maintained fall.

context_deltas.mechanism: Authorized speech and hidden communication meet sharp disputation and continually renewed discourse; the focus branch of song/diversion becomes a rival channel that answers received speech with self-generated sound.

activation_trace.role: Song and diversion supply the audience's competing acoustic and attentional channel.
Articulated speech supplies the addressed signal against which the focus behavior reacts.
A hidden or subtle sound supplies the low-volume revelatory channel that distraction can drown out.
Sharp verbal disputation turns non-reception into an antagonistic speech response.
Speech continually renewed as report supplies the discourse that remains active immediately before the focus reaction.

structural_cues: The sequence begins by distinguishing sourced speech at 53:3-4 and ends by moving from dispute and renewed discourse to reaction and state at 53:55-61.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies articulated speech, hidden sound, sharp dispute, renewed discourse, and focus song; I infer that the audience's sound actively occludes the address; alternatively samud may be entirely nonsonic distraction.

changed_reading.before: Heedless amusement is only a mood.
changed_reading.after: You produce a counter-channel of diversion that competes with, talks over, or acoustically screens the discourse confronting you.

context_deltas.mechanism: Endpoint, caution-awakening warning, accelerated nearness, and denied uncovering compress time around the focus; the permanence branch then reads as behavior that performs endlessness precisely when time is closing.

activation_trace.role: Ongoing permanence supplies the audience's enacted assumption that the present response can continue.
The terminal limit supplies a fixed endpoint against which focus duration becomes resistance.
Warning that awakens caution supplies the interruptive signal the continuing state refuses to heed.
Hurry and acceleration supply shrinking time rather than a remote horizon.
Lifting a cover supplies the removal that the source grammar denies to any alternative agent, making closure inescapable.

structural_cues: The run 53:56-61 accelerates from warning to nearness, non-removal, reaction, and finally a durative group state.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies endpoint, warning, accelerated nearness, unavailable uncovering, and focus permanence; I infer that persistence simulates unlimited time against closure; alternatively B009 may only intensify ordinary duration without a denial strategy.

changed_reading.before: They remain heedless for an unspecified while.
changed_reading.after: You enact a false forever, prolonging the same response exactly as the available interval collapses.

context_deltas.mechanism: The dominant mapped root makes striving purposeful and accountable, while its non-dominant mapped inventory contributes heedless going on one's face. Together with the focus's tireless travel, samud becomes energetic misinvestment rather than laziness.

activation_trace.role: Persistent travel supplies sustained expenditure in the focus state.
Purposeful movement toward an objective supplies agency and accountability for the course being pursued.
The non-dominant split inventory's neglectful going on one's face supplies the oblique image of effort without orientation.

structural_cues: 53:39-40 repeats striving, assigns it to the person, and says it will become visible before the focus's continued state.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies accountable purposeful striving, a non-dominant split image of neglectful going, and focus travel; I infer that samud is misdirected labor; alternatively the split branch may be only a lexical resonance and the striving passage may not characterize this audience.

changed_reading.before: Heedlessness is passive failure to act.
changed_reading.after: You work at your own distraction, spending real motion and persistence on a course whose misdirection will itself be shown.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier pairing of caused laughter and weeping becomes asymmetrical at 53:60: laughter spills outward while grief, tears, and voice are negated. The focus branch of still sorrow can therefore name an arrested transition, with grief present as pressure but not released as response.

activation_trace.role: Stillness and sorrowful composure supply the affect held motionless beneath the visible reaction.
Joy or wonder manifesting as laughter establishes one available affective outlet.
Causing another to weep establishes the paired capacity for grief before its later refusal.
Fullness overflowing into visibility supplies the outwardly discharged affect immediately before the focus.
Grief with tears and voice is the response explicitly negated, supplying the blocked outlet.

structural_cues: 53:43 pairs laughter and weeping; 53:60 repeats them asymmetrically, and 53:61 follows with a nominal group state.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies outward laughter, negated grief, and focus still sorrow; I infer that laughter blocks or masks a transition into grief; alternatively the sequence may contrast simple merriment with absent contrition without implying repression.

changed_reading.after: You may be frozen at the threshold of grief, displaying mirth while the sorrowful response remains immobilized.

context_deltas.mechanism: Self-magnification selects the pride pole of the focus's raised-head branch, and the immediately following command supplies its exact bodily inverse: head and body must descend.

activation_trace.role: Raised head, upright stance, pride, and bewilderment supply the posture that requires resolution.
Self-magnification strengthens pride as one motive for holding the head high.
Humbling descent supplies the social and devotional reversal of self-elevation.
Lowering the head and bending supplies the precise bodily inverse of the focus posture.

structural_cues: The wa-antum state in 53:61 retains the plural addressee and is immediately answered by the fa-imperative of 53:62.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies self-magnification, focus head-raising, and immediate head-lowering; I infer that 53:62 deliberately reverses their embodied stance; alternatively bewilderment may dominate B004, making the command reorientation rather than humiliation.

changed_reading.before: The final command follows a generic accusation of heedlessness.
changed_reading.after: You are caught with heads held high, and the next imperative answers that exact posture by bringing head and body down.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because stallion heat is a remote animal branch and the context never equates samud with sexuality; it remains anchored because B008 belongs directly to the focus root and desire, marital pairing, and generative fluid co-activate it. Downstream prose should present only an exploratory appetitive undertone, never a primary gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus word 2, samiduna, directly carries the branch of a stallion in sexual heat.

activation_trace.role: Sexual heat supplies a bodily arousal state and anchors the appetitive reading in the focus lexeme.
Inclination of desire supplies the appetite's directional pull in the surrounding discourse.
Marital pairing supplies a sexual and social frame for the arousal branch.
Fluid extending to semen supplies the reproductive material consequence of the activated appetite.

changed_reading.before: The audience is merely amused and inattentive.
changed_reading.after: The clause may flicker as appetitive heat: desire has captured bodily attention and sustains absorption before the command to bow.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it links juridical wound imagery to an affective swelling branch across different roots; it remains valid as a branch-backed model anchored in focus B007 and sharpened by self-magnification and visible overflow. Render it as an evoked injury-response pattern, not as a lexical translation of samiduna.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus word 2 has a branch of swelling with anger or swelling in a wound.

activation_trace.role: Swelling in anger or in a wound supplies the focus's inflamed reaction state.
A wound carrying obligatory compensation makes the warning root itself deliver an injury image that activates focus swelling.
Self-magnification supplies egoic pressure that can receive warning as insult or injury.
Fullness overflowing into appearance supplies the public discharge of the internal pressure through laughter.

changed_reading.after: The warning may land like an injury: self-importance swells into anger, and laughter becomes the visible discharge of that inflammation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the hair trigger comes from a proper-name occurrence and the resulting de-crowning image is form-distant; it remains anchored in the focus root's explicit head-shaving branch and gains a bodily endpoint from the following head-lowering branch. Use only as a weak imagistic echo, never as denotation or ritual claim.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus word 2 directly includes a branch of removing all hair from the head.

activation_trace.role: Complete removal of head hair supplies a stripping image anchored in the focus lexeme.
Growing hair supplies the material whose removal the focus branch imagines, though the source occurrence is a proper name.
Lowering the head supplies the next bodily motion, allowing stripping to function as a tentative de-crowning before descent.

changed_reading.before: Samud is only a mental or affective condition.
changed_reading.after: A remote image strips the raised head of its covering or status before that head is commanded downward.

strongest_changes: Static heedlessness became active counter-speech, sustained motion, and accountable mis-striving.
The raised-head branch became the exact posture reversed by the final prostration command.
Ongoing permanence against accelerated nearness became a strategy of temporal denial.
Still sorrow survived beside laughter as a blocked-affect reading rather than being discarded.
summary.what_was_special: One focus word activated coexisting mechanisms in sound, locomotion, posture, duration, and affect; the context changed each mechanism differently without forcing a single final sense, while split-root and form-distant activations remained visibly contained.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the raised-head branch is primarily pride or bewilderment.
Whether straight-ahead travel and permanence are live senses here or contextual metaphors.
How much weight the non-dominant س ع ي mapping should bear in the mis-striving model.
Whether the appetitive, wound, and stripped-head outliers are more than branch-level imagistic resonances.
